cases.name: foreign-valid-authority-chain
cases.reason: authority chain does not terminate at the destination repository genesis

cases.name: stale-valid-authority-ancestor
cases.reason: ordinary transaction authority is not the pinned current authority

cases.name: same-transaction-successor-object
cases.reason: successor-authority commits and releases wait for the next transaction

cases.name: successor-object-in-later-transaction
cases.reason: the later transaction pins the already-published successor

cases.name: malformed-extra-commit-signature
cases.reason: an extra all-zero signature entry is invalid and must not be tolerated

cases.name: release-first-signer-is-not-declarer
cases.reason: the first release signature must match declarer_key

cases.name: release-duplicate-cosigner
cases.reason: extra release signatures must be valid, authorized, and unique

cases.name: missing-ordinary-tree-closure
cases.reason: every newly reachable typed edge must resolve

cases.name: wrong-embedded-edge-type
cases.reason: outer and embedded types and expected graph edge types must match; not-exercised because levcs-identity has no closure-walking code path today, so there is nothing for this fixture to call yet -- this is Phase 2 IdentitySession/ProjectionCore work, not a Phase 0 test gap

cases.name: repository-policy-read-failure
cases.reason: policy evaluation is fail-closed; not-exercised because repository policy is instance-level I/O and this crate only sees policy already embedded in AuthorityBody, so a read failure cannot be constructed here -- exercised in levcs-instance/Phase 2 AdmissionAuth instead

cases.name: repository-policy-parse-failure
cases.reason: malformed policy is not equivalent to no policy; not-exercised for the same reason -- levcs-identity has no separate policy-parse step to feed malformed bytes into
